title: Safety Concept Steering in Vision-Language Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: VLMs are increasingly deployed and image-based attacks bypass text-only safety. Extending concept steering to VLMs addresses a concrete and growing attack surface. Clear chain from capability to practical defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: VLMs are large and require significant memory. Extracting concept vectors from vision-conditioned activations adds multimodal complexity. Setting up image-prompted unsafe content generation pipelines is non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single model, single concept direction, but the multimodal extraction and evaluation pipeline involves multiple steps. The VLM setup alone consumes significant time budget.
